name: Shojo Kishi Aria ~Shiryou no Oukoku to Inda no Oujo~
original_name: 処女騎士アリア ～死霊の王国と淫堕の王女～
source:
A perky virgin knight who was beloved by all went on a perilous quest to rid her father of a curse by a mysterious necromancer. Many magical terrors are in her way. Zombies, magibeasts and skeletons will stop at nothing to soil her sweet, pure hymen!! 

An Adventure Game. Aria has seven days to save her father... but can she protect her maidenhood?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098316.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个受所有人喜爱的元气处女骑士，为了解除父亲身上神秘死灵术士的诅咒，踏上了一场危险的征途。许多魔法恐怖挡在了她的路上。丧尸、魔法兽和骷髅不惜一切代价要玷污她甜美纯洁的处女之身！！一款冒险游戏。亚莉亚有七天时间拯救她的父亲……但她能保住自己的贞洁吗？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098316.html]DLsite English[/url]]
